content.short: Teleton is a Telegram SocialFi streaming app where viewers can earn rewards while watching video content.
content.description: Teleton is a SocialFi video streaming app built for Telegram. Its site describes a watch-to-earn model where viewers receive rewards for views, likes, and social actions while creators publish video content. It sits in the social category because creator activity, audience engagement, and rewards are the core loop. Teleton is a SocialFi video streaming app on Telegram, where you earn while you watch. For TON and Telegram users, Teleton turns community activity into a wallet-connected, reward-aware, or creator-focused experience.
